metadata.question: Did nighttime brightness over Houston decrease on May 18, 2024, compared to April 2024?

data.raw_code: The user asks: "Did nighttime brightness over Houston decrease on May 18, 2024, compared to April 2024?" Analysis: 1. Search Strategy: - Need nighttime brightness data - VIIRS Day/Night Band (DNB) data is appropriate - Collection: "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG" (VIIRS Cloud Masked Stray Light Corrected Nighttime Radiance) - Need monthly composite for April 2024 and specific day (May 18, 2024) - However, the monthly collection doesn't have daily data. Need daily VIIRS data: "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VNP46A2" (Daily DNB data) - Location: Houston, Texas area (use bounding box or point) 2. Masking Strategy: - VIIRS DNB data already has cloud masking applied in the monthly composite - For daily data, need to check quality flags or use available masked data 3. Logic: - Compare average radiance over Houston area for two time periods - Need to handle cases where data might be missing - Validate that pixel counts are sufficient after masking Plan: - Use VIIRS DNB monthly data for April 2024 - Use VIIRS DNB daily data for May 18, 2024 - Extract the 'avg_rad' band (average radiance) - Compare mean values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry for Houston area const houston = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-95.8, 29.6, -95.0, 30.2]); // Houston bounding box // 2. Define date ranges const april2024 = ee.DateRange('2024-04-01', '2024-04-30'); const may18 = ee.DateRange('2024-05-18', '2024-05-19'); // Single day // 3. Get monthly composite for April 2024 (VIIRS DNB monthly) const aprilCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterBounds(houston) .filterDate(april2024); // 4. Get daily data for May 18, 2024 (VIIRS DNB daily) const mayCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VNP46A2') .filterBounds(houston) .filterDate(may18); // 5. Check if collections have data const aprilSize = aprilCollection.size().getInfo(); const maySize = mayCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`April 2024 Images: ${aprilSize}, May 18 Images: ${maySize}`); // Case C1: No images found if (aprilSize === 0 || maySize === 0) { // Try fallback: use daily data for April too if monthly is empty const aprilDaily = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VNP46A2') .filterBounds(houston) .filterDate('2024-04-01', '2024-05-01'); const aprilDailySize = aprilDaily.size().getInfo(); console.log(`April Daily Images: ${aprilDailySize}`); if (aprilSize === 0 && aprilDailySize === 0) { console.log("No data for April 2024."); console.log("C1"); return; } if (maySize === 0) { console.log("No data for May 18, 2024."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Use daily collection for April if monthly is empty const aprilImage = (aprilSize > 0) ? aprilCollection.mean() : aprilDaily.mean().clip(houston); const mayImage = mayCollection.mean().clip(houston); } else { const aprilImage = aprilCollection.mean().clip(houston); const mayImage = mayCollection.mean().clip(houston); } // 6. Process images - get average radiance const aprilRad = aprilImage.select('avg_rad'); const mayRad = mayImage.select('avg_rad'); // 7. Check pixel counts const aprilCount = aprilRad.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: houston, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const mayCount = mayRad.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: houston, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); console.log(`April valid pixels: ${aprilCount}, May 18 valid pixels: ${mayCount}`); // Case C2: No valid pixels after processing if (aprilCount === 0 || mayCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 8. Calculate mean brightness values const aprilMean = aprilRad.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: houston, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const mayMean = mayRad.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: houston, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); console.log(`April mean radiance: ${aprilMean ? aprilMean.toFixed(4) : 'null'}`); console.log(`May 18 mean radiance: ${mayMean ? mayMean.toFixed(4) : 'null'}`); // 9. Validate results and determine answer // Check for invalid values (NaN, null, or unreasonable values - radiance should be positive) if (aprilMean === null || mayMean === null || isNaN(aprilMean) || isNaN(mayMean) || aprilMean < 0 || mayMean < 0) { console.log("Calculation produced invalid values."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 10. Compare values - Did brightness decrease? const brightnessDecreased = mayMean < aprilMean; if (brightnessDecreased) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
